skill.summary: Provides short-form videos showcasing kids' art classes to help parents see class atmosphere, student work, instructors, and enrollment details.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Art Class Video skill.
- Helps children's art studios create compelling short-form videos for marketing.
- Features include instructor introductions, finished-work showcases, and beginner-friendly content.
- Designed for use on websites, social media, and parent groups to boost enrollment.
